about: Browser corpus of VisTest: frames rendered by Chromium from tests/browser_corpus/templates, labels known before the frame exists. Written by `python scripts/browser_corpus.py --regenerate`; do not edit by hand.

capture.stability: frames until two in a row are byte-identical, 5000 ms limit

control: every frame drawn in two browsers started the same way; 0 pixels apart, or the capture stops

split.rule: by template, never by pair: held-out templates never take part in choosing a threshold, a preset or any other constant of the engine; they are only measured once a choice has been made on the calibration half

labels.SIGNAL: a change a person sees; a tool that stays green missed it
labels.NOISE: nothing a person sees changed; a tool that fails is wrong
labels.DISPUTED: judgement call left open: printed, never counted

table.title: orders table in an admin panel

cards.title: product cards in a catalogue grid

landing.title: marketing landing page with a hero and a chart

article.title: long serif text with a sidebar

fill.what: background colour of a filled button
fill.why: the colour in the stylesheet changed; at ΔE00 ≥ 4 the change is visible side by side, so a tool that stays green missed it

de2.label: DISPUTED
de2.why: decided by the maintainer on 2026-09-28: ΔE00 ≈ 2 sits at the edge of what a person sees side by side (≈1 is the just-noticeable difference). Kept in the corpus as DISPUTED: every tool's verdict is printed, none is counted as a false failure or a miss.
